This version changes the Shell core, so updating from the app asks for administrator approval once.

Many of these come from RubicBG's ReShell (shared with his permission). Thank you, RubicBG.

**New things you can write in your menu files**
- `str.fmt` fills values into a text: `str.fmt('{0} of {1}', sel.count, 10)` gives "2 of 10". `str.format` does the same; before, it returned nothing.
- `app.set`, `app.get`, `app.exists` and `app.remove` remember a value between menus, even after a restart. For example `cmd=app.set('fav', sel.dir)` on one item and `cmd=app.get('fav')` on another gives you a folder you can come back to. Values are kept for your Windows account only.
- `path.file.save_box` shows a Save As box and gives back the path that was chosen, for example `path.file.save_box('Text|*.txt', user.desktop, 'list.txt')`.
- `path.dir.box` can start in a folder and show your own title: `path.dir.box(sel.dir, 'Pick a folder')`.
- `path.absolute('..\backup')` and `path.relative(sel.path)` turn a path into a full one, or into one that starts from the folder you right-clicked in. Before, both returned nothing.
- `io.move` can move a file to another drive, and takes an optional third value to replace a file that is already there.
- `input()` can show a drop-down list to pick from: `input('Size', 'Pick a size', '', ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'])`. `input.selected` tells you which item was picked.
- `indexof()` accepts a number as the place to put an item when nothing matches.
- `key.return` works as a name for the Enter key, as the docs already said.

**Fixes**
- `key.ctrl()` is true while Ctrl is held. Before, it never was.
- `col=` no longer removes the `keys=` text of the same item.
- `color.rgb(255, 0, 0)` and `color(255, 0, 0)` give red. Red and blue were swapped and the color was see-through.
- `color.random` gives a random visible color. Before, it was always black and see-through.
- `type.file`, `type.dir` and the other `type.*` names give their numbers, and `path.type('C:\Windows')` tells you what a path is. A snippet that compared these could never match before.
- `sel.type(5)` with fewer items selected no longer crashes Explorer.
- `theme.item.back.select` and the other `theme.item` color names give the theme's colors. `theme.item.border.normal` and `theme.item.border.select` are new.
- `cmd.show`, `cmd.visible` and `shell.maximized` and its friends give their values. Before, they returned nothing.
- `sys.is7orgreater`, `sys.is8orgreater` and `sys.is81orgreater` are true on Windows 10 and 11.
- The config check accepts `sys.datetime.s`, `.h`, `.d`, `.dw` and `.m`, which already worked in menus.
- `this.type` gives 0 for an item, 1 for a menu and 2 for a separator for the items you add too, as documented. If you worked around the old numbers, check those lines.
- `str.split('a,,b', ',')` gives the two parts "a" and "b". Before, it gave one part, "a,b".
- `reg.get` and `reg.set` handle binary values, and `reg.keys` and `reg.values` no longer cut long names short.
- `var.name[0]` picks one part of a `var` value, as `$name[0]` does, and asking for a place past the end of a text gives nothing instead of garbage.
- A round (radial) gradient in a theme is centred across the menu.

**Snippets**
- The bundled snippets all still work. We checked RubicBG's snippets that were left out because Shell lacked these functions. Two of them load now, but they change Windows settings outside Shell (one edits the registry, one changes file permissions), so they stay out of the Snippets page. The others still need functions Shell doesn't have yet.
- The [Snippets](https://abdullah-masood-05.github.io/Shell/snippets/) page lists what is still missing.

**Docs**
- New and fixed functions are described in the [Functions](https://abdullah-masood-05.github.io/Shell/functions/) pages.
